_comment: C0-14 pixverse bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（kling/vidu/jimeng），related 写 3 条。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。备案号（爱诗多模态/爱诗通用实时拼音号）属登记号原样保留。

axes.model_access: In-house model line (official release narrative: V5/C1 video models, R1/R2 general real-time world models — the R series leads with real-time interactive generation); users do not pick bare models. An open-weights line — no official statement verified.
axes.runtime: Web (pixverse.ai) + app (as seen in site navigation); generation on the vendor's cloud. The R series' "real-time" is cloud streaming generation, not local running.
axes.local_files: Works stored account-side in the cloud, generation history visible on the web works page; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); the R-series real-time line is the differentiator (official narrative: interact while it generates); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video, image-to-video, video stylization/effects-template lines (as seen in site navigation); the R-series real-time world models target interactive FMV games/digital-human scenarios (official release narrative); effects-play templates are its community-facing hook.
axes.context: Organized by account works; cross-session memory — no official statement verified. The R series' "state continuation" is an in-model capability, not product memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line. Filing: Aishi multimodal Beijing-AiShiDuoMoTai-202507250115 + Aishi general real-time Beijing-AiShiTongYongShiShi-202608010283 (cross-verified on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's official disclosure page and the Beijing municipal government site's news page, 2026-10-22) — the subject is the model layer.
axes.fit: Fits: effects-template/play-oriented short video, social-distribution material, testing real-time interactive scenarios (the R series), domestic direct connection. Does not fit: model self-selection, open weights, a serious cinematic long-take focus.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **The R series' actual latency and consistency in real-time interaction** (official narrative vs. real experience)
- **The commercial licensing surface of effect templates** (the copyright chain of template materials)
- **Duration/watermark differences between free and paid tiers** (D9: prices not collected; behavior to be measured)
unknowns:
- The open-weights line (no official statement verified)
- The R series' opening surface to third-party developers (no official statement verified)
- The training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both domestic video leaders: Kling leans ecosystem and realism, PixVerse leans play and real-time.
Both domestic in-house models: Vidu leads on consistency control, PixVerse on template play and real-time.
Both domestic play-oriented creation benches: Jimeng unifies image+video inside the CapCut ecosystem, PixVerse is a standalone video site.
